2	
3	**Specification ID**: #{#fcv1a}  
4	**Authority**: system  
5	**Priority**: Critical

9	## Overview
10	
11	This specification documents the migration of the expense categorization system from user-scoped to family-scoped categories, ensuring that category assignments and vendor rules are visible and shared across all active family members.
12	
13	## Problem Statement
14	
15	Prior to this change, the expense tracking system had an architectural inconsistency:
16	
17	- **Receipts**: Family-visible (via `family_id` and family RLS policies)
18	- **Categories**: User-private (via `user_id` - NOT visible to other family members)
19	- **Vendor Rules**: User-private (via `user_id` - NOT shared across family)
20	- **Transactions**: Family-visible, but missing active status check
21	
22	This caused the following issues:
23	
24	1. When User A categorized a receipt as "Groceries", User B (same family) could see the receipt but NOT the category assignment
25	2. Vendor rules created by User A did not apply to receipts uploaded by User B
26	3. Transaction exclusion decisions were potentially visible to inactive family members
27	
28	## Solution: Family-Scoped Categories

45	)

Pure string logic — a real (if minor) gap; would need extraction to test cleanly.
